content: Expo SDK 56.0.12 is the current stable release (May 2026). Ships React Native 0.85, React 19.2, TypeScript 6.0.3. iOS minimum is 16.4 (up from 15.1), requires Xcode 26.4. New Architecture is on by default. expo-router is bundled and has forked from React Navigation in SDK 56 — do not install @react-navigation/* packages separately; use expo-router entry points directly.
